title: Tell Eldridge the Truth

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: It's you. You've returned to witness my suffering. Tell me, what is the world saying about the tragedy of Eldridge Uchuu?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's you. You've returned to witness my suffering. Tell me, what is the world saying about the tragedy of Eldridge Uchuu?

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Don't tell me, I can't bear to hear it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't tell me, I can't bear to hear it!

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Oh then tell me if you must! Nothing can be worse than the torment of exile!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh then tell me if you must! Nothing can be worse than the torment of exile!

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: I knew it! The bacon burps were a sign! Oh, how could I have done such a thing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I knew it! The bacon burps were a sign! Oh, how could I have done such a thing?

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: You think so? You don't think it was horribly passe?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think so? You don't think it was horribly passe?

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: That's right. Who is anyone to question my taste? I'm a Curzona!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's right. Who is anyone to question my taste? I'm a Curzona!

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Ohh. Please, was there anything else?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ohh. Please, was there anything else?

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: I couldn't... I didn't... but now you mention it, I do remember feeling a strange desire to share things with the less fortunate. Damn Bo Bo's snuff!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I couldn't... I didn't... but now you mention it, I do remember feeling a strange desire to share things with the less fortunate. Damn Bo Bo's snuff!

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Truly?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Truly?

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Tell me. Was there anything else?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me. Was there anything else?

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: *Gasp* Are you BLACKMAILING me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: *Gasp* Are you BLACKMAILING me?

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Well, I don't care for the way you're stating it. Tell me now and tell me extra quickly: was there anything else?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I don't care for the way you're stating it. Tell me now and tell me extra quickly: was there anything else?

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Yes... it could be a way to make money from my vast fashion holo collection!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes... it could be a way to make money from my vast fashion holo collection!

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Ha ha! Not charge. You are funny. But tell me honestly: was there anything else?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha ha! Not charge. You are funny. But tell me honestly: was there anything else?

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: No... take it back, tell me that you're lying...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No... take it back, tell me that you're lying...

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: EVERYONE is not Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona! Everyone is not the laughing stock of the Spire! That's it, I'm finished, I'm going to lay down and DIE.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: EVERYONE is not Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona! Everyone is not the laughing stock of the Spire! That's it, I'm finished, I'm going to lay down and DIE.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Ohh, my life is over. I'm finished. How can I bear it? I'm going to lay down here and DIE.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ohh, my life is over. I'm finished. How can I bear it? I'm going to lay down here and DIE.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: HOW can it get worse? What did I do, wear red? Make a pun? Join a grassroots community action campaign?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: HOW can it get worse? What did I do, wear red? Make a pun? Join a grassroots community action campaign?

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: You don't understand anything! Tell me no one captured it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't understand anything! Tell me no one captured it?

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Razlo... Razlo... the little snitch who failed Attitudinizing? How dare he! Oh if Aunt Mary sees those pictures I'll be excommunicated... you MUST get them for me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Razlo... Razlo... the little snitch who failed Attitudinizing? How dare he! Oh if Aunt Mary sees those pictures I'll be excommunicated... you MUST get them for me!

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Then I'm doomed. DOOMED!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then I'm doomed. DOOMED!

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: Please, I'll do ANYTHING!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please, I'll do ANYTHING!

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: How can you be so cruel? Here, take this fashion holo and get out of my pitiful sight!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How can you be so cruel? Here, take this fashion holo and get out of my pitiful sight!

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: That Razlo is a greedy upstart. A snake. He'll want something, trust me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That Razlo is a greedy upstart. A snake. He'll want something, trust me.

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: My... how can you be so cruel to me in my suffering? Knowing I have no choice? Fine! You leech! You vampire! Just help me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My... how can you be so cruel to me in my suffering? Knowing I have no choice? Fine! You leech! You vampire! Just help me!

nodes.speaker: Eldridge-Uchuu Nyx Curzona
nodes.text: THAT is a first edition of Pomp & Frippery! More than you deserve! Now leave me drown my sorrows in beautiful degradation. I never want to see you again!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: THAT is a first edition of Pomp & Frippery! More than you deserve! Now leave me drown my sorrows in beautiful degradation. I never want to see you again!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, it took a while, but I discovered the truth.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, it took a while, but I discovered the truth.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well, it took a while, but I discovered the truth.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well, it took a while, but I discovered the truth.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You promised me a reward!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You promised me a reward!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You promised me a reward!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You promised me a reward!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's really not that bad.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's really not that bad.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's really not that bad.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's really not that bad.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Trust me, you need to know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Trust me, you need to know.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Trust me, you need to know.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Trust me, you need to know.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You ordered a ham daiquiri.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You ordered a ham daiquiri.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You ordered a ham daiquiri.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You ordered a ham daiquiri.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You tried to start a library.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You tried to start a library.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You tried to start a library.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You tried to start a library.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You forgot to turn your sweat inhibitor on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You forgot to turn your sweat inhibitor on.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You forgot to turn your sweat inhibitor on.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You forgot to turn your sweat inhibitor on.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I dunno, it sounds quite good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I dunno, it sounds quite good.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I dunno, it sounds quite good.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I dunno, it sounds quite good.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It really is the height of bad taste.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It really is the height of bad taste.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It really is the height of bad taste.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It really is the height of bad taste.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If you like it, that's what matters.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you like it, that's what matters.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If you like it, that's what matters.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If you like it, that's what matters.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think it's a good idea.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think it's a good idea.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think it's a good idea.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think it's a good idea.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can see it now, The Eldridge Uchuu Education Centre.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can see it now, The Eldridge Uchuu Education Centre.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can see it now, The Eldridge Uchuu Education Centre.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can see it now, The Eldridge Uchuu Education Centre.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's not what I...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's not what I...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's not what I...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's not what I...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're lucky your aunt doesn't know...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're lucky your aunt doesn't know...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're lucky your aunt doesn't know...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're lucky your aunt doesn't know...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just stating a fact.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just stating a fact.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Just stating a fact.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Just stating a fact.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't think libraries are meant to charge money...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think libraries are meant to charge money...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't think libraries are meant to charge money...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't think libraries are meant to charge money...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Calm down, everyone sweats.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Calm down, everyone sweats.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Calm down, everyone sweats.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Calm down, everyone sweats.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can't. It's the awful truth.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't. It's the awful truth.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can't. It's the awful truth.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can't. It's the awful truth.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's only a big deal if you make it one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's only a big deal if you make it one.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's only a big deal if you make it one.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's only a big deal if you make it one.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm afraid it gets worse.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm afraid it gets worse.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm afraid it gets worse.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm afraid it gets worse.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A kid called Razlo got it on camera and is going to use it to blackmail you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A kid called Razlo got it on camera and is going to use it to blackmail you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: A kid called Razlo got it on camera and is going to use it to blackmail you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: A kid called Razlo got it on camera and is going to use it to blackmail you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not helping you anymore.

pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not helping you anymore.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not helping you anymore.

nodes.text: How?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It'll cost...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It'll cost...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It'll cost...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It'll cost...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Looks like it. You promised a reward for the info?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Looks like it. You promised a reward for the info?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Looks like it. You promised a reward for the info?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Looks like it. You promised a reward for the info?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I want your apartment in the Spire.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I want your apartment in the Spire.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I want your apartment in the Spire.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I want your apartment in the Spire.

nodes.text: OK. How?

pronounText.TextTheyVersion: OK. How?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A fashion holo? That's it?

pronounText.TextTheyVersion: A fashion holo? That's it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nice to do business with you!
